# Health for California

> > California health insurance resource covering Covered California enrollment, Medi-Cal eligibility, ACA plans, and agent services.

Health for California provides comprehensive guidance on navigating California's health insurance marketplace, including Covered California applications, income reporting requirements, plan comparisons, and connections to certified insurance brokers. The site serves individuals, families, and agents seeking affordable healthcare coverage options under the Affordable Care Act.

## Key Topics

- Covered California
- California health insurance
- Affordable Care Act (ACA)
- Medi-Cal
- Income changes and reporting
- Health insurance agents and brokers
- Enrollment process and requirements
- Application updates and household changes
- Plan selection and deductibles
- Obamacare marketplace
- Document verification
- Premium subsidies (APTC)
- Low-income coverage options
- Healthcare.gov
- California Association of Health Underwriters (CAHU)

## Covered California Enrollment & Applications

- [Covered California Online Application | Health for CA](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/covered-california/application): Complete guide to Covered California application process and eligibility
- [How to Report Application Changes | Health for California](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/covered-california/application/report-changes): Guide to reporting Covered California application updates and changes
- [FAQs for Covered California Document Proofs](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/covered-california/document-proofs/faqs): FAQ on Covered California document verification and enrollment proofs
- [Health Insurance Income Report Change | Health for California](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/report-income-changes): How to report income changes to Covered California for premium updates

## California Health Insurance Options

- [Affordable Care Act in California | Health for California](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/affordable-care-act): Overview of ACA/Obamacare and Covered California marketplace exchange
- [Low Income Individual & Family Health Insurance Options](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/california-health-insurance-options-for-low-income-individuals-and-families): Affordable California health insurance options for low-income families
- [Getting Affordable California Health Insurance | HFC](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/the-challenge-of-getting-affordable-california-health-insurance): Guide to affordable health insurance through Covered California and Medi-Cal

## Insurance Agents & Brokers

- [Health Insurance Brokers in CA | Health for California](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/covered-california/brokers): Network of certified California health insurance brokers and agents
- [Molina Healthcare Broker and Agent Support | Health for CA](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/molina-healthcare-agent-support-and-broker-portal): Molina Healthcare broker portal and agent support resources guide
- [Can Health Insurance Agents Charge Fees? | Health for CA](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/can-health-insurance-agents-charge-fees): Analysis of California health insurance agent fees and commission legality
- [What Should Commissions Be for Health Insurance Agents?](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/what-should-commissions-be-for-health-insurance-agents): Discussion of health insurance agent commission structures post-ACA

## Plan Selection & Healthcare Guidance

- [Discover the Difference Between High Deductible and Low Deductible Plans](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/difference-between-high-deductible-low-deductible-plans): Comparison of HDHP vs LDHP health insurance plans and costs
- [New Plan Options from Covered California | Health for CA](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/new-plan-selection-options): Updates on Covered California member-level enrollment and APTC options
- [How to Choose Between the Doctor's Office, Urgent Care or ER](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/choosing-between-doctors-office-urgent-care-or-the-er): Healthcare decision guide comparing doctor's office, urgent care, and ER
- [Dealing with Expensive Prescriptions | Health for California](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/blog/prescriptions-too-expensive): Solutions for managing expensive prescription medication costs in CA

## Support & Troubleshooting

- [Covered California Website Not Working? Find Out Why](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/covered-california-website/problems): Troubleshooting guide for Covered California website technical issues
- [Where is the Affordable in Health Care? | Health for CA](https://www.healthforcalifornia.com/where-is-the-affordable-in-health-care): Analysis of ACA affordability and California health insurance rate increases
